text:
emma: quick heads-up: onboarding users hitting the new sampleapp see intermittent SSE parse errors around token refresh + occasional re-ordered chunks. repro on web and mobile.
ryan: can you paste a tiny repro/logs?
emma: steps: start stream, wait ~45s (we force refresh jitter), sometimes client logs 'parse error: unexpected "\n"' then reconnects and UI shows parts out of order. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-22T15:04:10Z] sse: connected
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] auth: refresh start
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] sse: recv chunk seq=123 data="Hello"
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] sse: recv chunk seq=124 data="World"
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] client: parse error: unexpected "\n"
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] client: reconnect with last_event_id=124
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] sse: recv chunk seq=124 data="World" // duplicate
[2026-03-22T15:04:55Z] sse: recv chunk seq=125 data="!" // arrives after duplicate -> UI shows World then Hello+!
```
ryan: looks like three issues: (1) a splitter/parser handles boundary differently on web vs mobile (2) aborting inflight on refresh causes duplicate final chunk, (3) resume ordering not enforced on reconnect.
claire: SDK parity note: mobile used to buffer lines and emit on full newline; web emits on every "data:" line. that explains ordering diffs.
emma: fix plan:
- standardize SSE parse logic across sdks: emit on complete event (header+double newline) not per data-line.
- change sampleapps to not abort inflight on refresh; instead tag next connect and let server resume.
- client-side dedupe by event-id/sequence for 2s window; fallback to checksum if missing.
- add server-side resume ordering enforcement: when accepting last_event_id, ensure queued events older than resume point are not re-emitted. open infra ticket.
ryan: also add unit tests: simulate mid-event auth refresh, fragmented chunks, and assert final ordering deterministic.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-4210: ensure server resume is idempotent and preserves ordering.
dev-tool-bot: CI runs queued: sse-parity-tests, expected ~4m.
claire: i'll push a small web sdk patch for the parser and sampleapp tweak. emma, can you handle mobile parity and the UI masking for duplicates?
emma: yes. i'll also add a tiny onboarding blurb: "Streams may briefly reconnect while credentials refresh; content is deduplicated and ordering preserved."
ryan: great. once patches in staging let's run stress with jittered refresh at high concurrency.
emma: marking follow-ups in tracker: DEX-214 (parser parity), DEX-215 (client dedupe), DEX-216 (ui masking), DEX-217 (telemetry sse_resume_dup).
claire: thanks — closing thread, will reopen on regressions. :white_check_mark:
